RESULT v1 | kce61ae4658 | Ranking by encode speed: msgpack > pickle > JSON (msgpack has no text parsing, pickle skips schema, JSON parses strings). By size: msgpack < pickle < JSON (binary vs repr vs verbose text). Justification: JSON is human-readable but slow/large; pickle is fast but Python-only; msgpack is compact and cross-language — pick msgpack for wire transfer, JSON for debuggability.

RESULT v1 | kbdfee623bf | JSON: largest and slowest—text encoding adds structural and numeric overhead. Pickle: medium size and fastest—Python-native binary serialization minimizes conversion overhead. Msgpack: smallest or near-smallest and moderately fast—compact binary encoding reduces size while retaining cross-language efficiency.
